entities.summary: Hryhorii Skovoroda, also Gregory Skovoroda or Grigory Skovoroda, was a Ukrainian philosopher, poet, teacher and a composer of liturgical music. His significant influence on his contemporaries and succeeding generations and his way of life were universally regarded as Socratic, and he was often called a "Socrates".
